LAW AND MOTION 301, PETITIONER THOMAS AGEE'S PETITION FOR WRIT OF MANDATE TO RESTORE THOMAS AGEE TO THE PARKMERCED RESIDENTS' ORGANIZATION (PRO) BOARD OF DIRECTORS, TO ISSUE NEEDED PROTECTIVE ORDERS, AND TO GRANT OTHER RELIEF. THE EVIDENCE SUGGESTS THAT PLAINTIFF WAS A MEMBER AND HAD PAID HIS DUES, AT LEAST AT THE BEGINNING OF HIS CURRENT TERM IN DECEMBER 2006 WHEN HE WAS APPOINTED TO A VACANCY TO THE BOARD. THEREFORE, HE COULD ONLY BE REMOVED BY A UNANIMOUS VOTE, AND HE IS ENTITLED TO BE REINSTATED. HIS OTHER REQUESTED RELIEF IS DENIED. IN ANY FUTURE PLEADINGS, PLAINTIFF IS DIRECTED TO COMPLY WITH C.R.C. 2.104 AND 2.108. PETITIONER IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189
